title: GET /api/<ns>/compliance/{client_id} (HA Core view of the integration)
description: Unauthenticated, 1 request/s per IP. Either the neutral body {v:1, status:'unknown', ts:<now>} (unknown client, unsigned status, toggle off) or a signed restricting status relayed verbatim from the hub. 'compliant' is never exposed (indistinguishable from unknown by design). The iPhone and iPad app verifies sig (fixtures/crypto/compliance-vectors), not the age of ts; the Android apps do not poll this view.
